title: Can I Publish My Improved Version?
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: A traffic-light card for each license that answers one question: may you publish an improved version, and what must you do?

educational.topic: What each license allows when you publish an improved version
learningObjectives: The learner will decide whether an improved version of a resource may be published under its license, and state what you must do.
prerequisites: The six Creative Commons licenses from [Chapter 2](../../chapters/02-open-licenses-attribution/index.md) and derivative works from [Chapter 15](../../chapters/15-improving-resources-with-ai/index.md).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: What does the license say about derivatives?
What must I add to my version?
commonMisconceptions: An AI edit removes the original license
Any open license lets you publish a changed version
assessmentOpportunities: A resource is CC BY-ND. May you publish your improved version?
A resource is CC BY-SA. What must you do?
A resource has no license. May you publish an improved version?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Poster zones
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
